narrative.overview: A hand-styled provisions atelier rendered as a website: warm blush and rosé page surfaces, white furniture, and full-bleed photography of grazing boards styled like floral arrangements. The header is a gallery plaque — the framed logo hung between thin rules on a white wall — and every page closes with a delicate double-line flourish above the footer. Saturated color appears only twice, berry-rose on controls and sage on the active nav item, so the food carries the chroma. Owner is still exploring the north star; Provisions Larder and Garden-Party Editorial remain candidates.
keyCharacteristics: Photography-first pages with aspect-locked full-bleed bands
980px centered column inside full-width color bands
Framed logo plaque header; double-line flourish above the footer
Two-accent discipline: berry controls, sage location, peach links-on-photo

rules.name: The Two Accents Rule
rules.body: Berry rose and sage are the only saturated colors; berry on interactive controls, sage only marks the current page.

rules.name: The Quiet Page Rule
rules.body: One Baskerville display moment per page; all other text is Spinnaker.

dos: Do keep photography dominant; text lives on bands, cards, or dimmed photo
Do fit containers to owner images with aspect-ratio; never fixed pixel heights there
Do ship owner renders byte-for-byte from _assets/studio/
donts: Don't reorder/merge/rename the hashed css/b*.css files
Don't crop, resize, or recompress owner-supplied images
Don't introduce new saturated hues or typefaces outside a redesign
Don't add a form backend; contact stays mailto
